t01.name: Upstairs towels, bath mat and cloths
t01.desc: Wash and replace towels, bath mat and cleaning cloths.

t02.name: Kitchen counters and table
t02.desc: Wipe and sanitize counters and dining table.

t05.name: Air fryers, microwave and toaster
t05.desc: Clean appliance interiors/exteriors as appropriate; unplug toaster first.

t06.name: Stove, fridge exterior and kitchen island
t06.desc: Clean the stovetop and wipe the fridge exterior and island.

t08.name: Brush the dog
t08.desc: Brush coat and tidy up loose fur.

t09.name: Pick up dog poop
t09.desc: Collect waste from the yard and dispose of it safely.

t10.name: Clean the fridge
t10.desc: Remove expired food and wipe shelves and drawers.

t11.name: Dishes
t11.desc: Wash dishes that need handwashing and tidy the sink.

t12.name: Middle flight of stairs
t12.desc: Clear items and vacuum/sweep the stairs.

t13.name: Upstairs bathroom
t13.desc: Clean toilet, sink and counter; tidy up, clean mirrors without leaving streaks and replace toilet paper.

t14.name: Downstairs bathroom
t14.desc: Clean toilet, sink and counter; tidy up, clean mirrors without leaving streaks and replace toilet paper.

t15.name: Bathtub / shower
t15.desc: Scrub the tub/shower and rinse away residue.

t16.name: Laundry machines and top
t16.desc: Wipe washer/dryer exteriors and the top surface.

t17.name: Take out garbage and recycling
t17.desc: Take household bins to the appropriate collection area.

t18.name: Collect indoor garbage
t18.desc: Empty garbage bins throughout the house and replace liners as needed.

t19.name: Load the dishwasher
t19.desc: Load dirty dishes and start it if appropriate.

t20.name: Load the dishwasher & Unload the dishwasher
t20.desc: Load dirty dishes and start it if appropriate & Put clean dishes away.

t22.name: Dust shared areas
t22.desc: Dust tables and surfaces in the main hallway and the hallway toward the downstairs bathroom.

t23.name: Windows and sliding door
t23.desc: Clean accessible windows and focus on the sliding glass door.

t25.name: Shovel snow
t25.desc: Clear snow from agreed paths and entrance.

t26.name: Mow the lawn
t26.desc: Mow lawn when needed and conditions allow.

t27.name: Pull weeds
t27.desc: Pull weeds from agreed garden/yard areas.

t28.name: Trim hedges
t28.desc: Trim hedges where safe and appropriate.
